steps.title: Confirm account and read the two-state contract
steps.command:
: "${LAB_ROOT:?Source scripts/env.sh first}"
: "${AWS_PROFILE:?Export your authenticated AWS profile name}"
: "${TF_VAR_expected_account_id:?Export your intended 12-digit AWS account ID}"
: "${TF_VAR_lab_id:?Keep one distinctive lab ID for this session and its cleanup}"
export AWS_REGION="${TF_VAR_region:-us-west-2}"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="$AWS_REGION"
export TF_VAR_region="$AWS_REGION"
test "$(aws sts get-caller-identity --profile "$AWS_PROFILE" --query Account --output text)" = "$TF_VAR_expected_account_id"
# Stop if identity validation fails. Planning can read AWS; apply creates resources.

cat "$LAB_ROOT/labs/02-remote-state/README.md"

steps.title: Prepare and review the backend bucket
steps.command:
cd "$LAB_ROOT/run/02-remote-state/bootstrap"
${EDITOR:-vi} main.tf
terraform init -lockfile=readonly
terraform fmt
terraform validate
terraform plan -out=bootstrap.tfplan
terraform show bootstrap.tfplan

steps.title: Apply the reviewed bootstrap plan
steps.command:
cd "$LAB_ROOT/run/02-remote-state/bootstrap"
terraform apply bootstrap.tfplan
export STATE_BUCKET="$(terraform output -raw bucket_name)"

steps.title: Configure the workload backend using the actual bucket
steps.command:
cd "$LAB_ROOT/run/02-remote-state/workload"
${EDITOR:-vi} main.tf
: "${STATE_BUCKET:?Read the bootstrap bucket_name output first}"
: "${AWS_REGION:?Set the same region as bootstrap}"
: "${TF_VAR_expected_account_id:?Set the intended account}"
cat > backend.hcl <<EOF
bucket              = "${STATE_BUCKET}"
key                 = "workload/terraform.tfstate"
region              = "${AWS_REGION}"
encrypt             = true
use_lockfile        = true
allowed_account_ids = ["${TF_VAR_expected_account_id}"]
EOF
terraform init -lockfile=readonly -backend-config=backend.hcl
terraform fmt
terraform validate
terraform plan -out=workload.tfplan
terraform show workload.tfplan

steps.title: Apply the reviewed workload plan, then run lock contention
steps.command:
cd "$LAB_ROOT/run/02-remote-state/workload"
terraform apply workload.tfplan
# The local 45-second delay is intentional.
cat "$LAB_ROOT/labs/02-remote-state/README.md"
# Follow the two-process contention experiment. Never disable or manually remove its lock.

cleanup.title: Retire the workload and migrate its empty state before deleting the bucket
cleanup.command:
cat "$LAB_ROOT/labs/02-remote-state/README.md"
# Follow the complete Teardown order section: workload destroy, state pull,
# explicit local backend migration, empty-state checks, then bootstrap destroy.
# Do not run bootstrap destroy while the workload still depends on its backend.
